hazards.control: Only qualified people at the drive, transformer, and junction box; lockout before cable work.

name: Motor and seal section
function: The oil-filled three-phase motor at the bottom of the assembly and the seal section above it that equalizes pressure, isolates the motor oil, and carries the pump thrust.

tabs.overview: Long, small-diameter motor cooled by the fluid flowing past it to the intake; the seal chambers use bags or labyrinths.
tabs.engineering: Voltage and horsepower per the pump; sensor package below the motor.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
